instruction:
Write back parameters in the native Altium schematic `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\oscillator_core.SchDoc` instead of exporting CSV. Open the schematic in Altium Designer, add the user parameter `Tolerance` only to the 4 resistor components below, then save the modified native document as `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\oscillator_tolerance.SchDoc`.

Requirements:
- `R42` must have `Tolerance=1%`.
- `R33`, `R39`, and `R34` must each have `Tolerance=5%`.
- `V24`, `C1`, `Q16`, `C3`, and `L1` must not gain a `Tolerance` parameter.
- Do not change any existing designator, Value, Comment, or other existing information. This is a targeted native `.SchDoc` edit, not a text-transcription task.
source: Local Altium example `Simulation Quick Start/6_Oscillator.SchDoc`; benchmark task materially redesigned from the text-only degeneration and should receive a source refresh note.
